kicker: For what you've stopped praying over
truth: You know every dry bone in the valley by name. Now speak to them.
prayer: Lord, I've been describing what's dead instead of speaking to it. Today I open my mouth: whatever in me is dry, hear the word of the Lord. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

save: Save this for the valley you're standing in
